notes.title: Update description on April 12th
notes.notes:
Fixed: Game crashes when dividing by 0

Thank you very much "Phae c:" for reporting this bug

notes.title: Controller support and player feedback modifications
notes.notes:
Contents of this update:
1. Implemented Xbox handle control support, using the built-in handle control, and does not support Steam controller input.
2. Based on player feedback in the discussion forum, some errors and unreasonable aspects have been corrected.
3. In order to support Steam Deck, some layouts and font sizes have been modified.
4. In the last three levels of mathematics, prompt props have been added to reduce the difficulty.

Here we are very grateful to the players who have provided opinions and feedback in the community center. Some have put forward pertinent opinions, some have pointed out unreasonable or wrong places, and some have given negative comments. These are all valuable opinions to us. . We will collect player feedback and reflect it in the next version update.

notes.title: Sudoku- add new content
notes.notes: After Sudoku passed, some new content has added.

notes.title: MagicMath is released
notes.notes:
We have released a book about mathematics. We are all independent developers with children, and we want to develop some games that children can play, which may be simple, but have some interesting experiences and knowledge in them.

Some of the three-star contents may be a bit difficult and require patient companionship with an adult. Not all contents are supported by hints. You need to explore by yourself.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44234405/87bc01b67d6b5f451111e9ff223d1a488bd293e8.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44234405/a26075e61cf5d0d65f326b38f7e8124f914f4c99.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44234405/f3929d32977d08e6976c44912aaa7f02fbebfc5c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44234405/0375dd79bc3eb349ba6d5c40d779bff6622f7fec.jpg[/img][/url]
For levels like Sudoku and Number Bridge, after passing three stars, there are still some new contents that you can continue to challenge. Of course, they are not difficult contents. If you like more difficult ones, you can leave a message in the comment area. Looking forward to it Updates for the next version.
